pr.title: Lead the Projects page with the list
pr.head: 3e91071a182b52c84dbdabd2bffdb837ff10830b

summary: The site's Projects page is the home page of a repository's Projector site. It lists every plan under docs/projects in one table per status, with columns for priority, owner, and the project's name. Before this change, two things sat above the list: a line that counted the projects and explained status and priority, and a folded How projects work introduction rendered from docs/projects/README.md. The page also showed an Owner column that only one plan in this repository filled in.
This change makes the list the first thing on the page:

• The count and legend line is gone. showProjects draws the heading, then the filter box, then the status groups. The proposed-project count, which only that line used, goes with it.
  • The introduction moves to the bottom. The folded How projects work section now follows the last status group, just above the site footer.
  • The Owner column disappears here. The completed review-scripts plan no longer names an owner. The page already draws the Owner column only when some plan names one, so no plan in this repository brings it back. A repository whose plans name owners keeps the column.
The review left one finding open: the proposed-projects plan, which is in-progress, still specifies the count this change removes.

cards.title: Terms
cards.html:
• Proposed project: a plan that an open pull request adds. The page lists it in its status group with a Proposed #N badge.
  • #sidebody: the element that frame draws a page's content into. The site footer sits outside it.
  • site.js: the compiled JavaScript the site serves, built from site/src/site.ts and committed beside it.

groups.title: The list leads the Projects page
groups.kicker: Drops the count line and moves the introduction below the list
intro: showProjects builds the Projects page. It now draws the <h1>, the filter box, and the status groups, with nothing between the heading and the filter. Once docs/projects/README.md loads, it appends the folded introduction to the end of the page content instead of inserting it before the filter.
The compiled site.js carries the same edit. The page test that drew a proposed project now asserts that no class="note" line appears, where it used to assert the count's text.

checks.text: Rebuilding with npm ci, npm run check, and npm run build in site/ left site/assets/site.js unchanged, so the compiled file matches the TypeScript.

files.note: showProjects drops the count line and appends the introduction after the status groups.

checks.text: The proposed-projects plan is in-progress and still requires the count this line no longer draws: its § 2.3 bullet and example, its § 2.6 file table, its § 3 rationale, and its § 4 acceptance criterion that "the note says 1 of them proposed in open pull requests". CLAUDE.md asks that docs/ describe the current behavior and change with it. Update the plan in this pull request so its § 4 row expects no note.
frame renders the footer after </main>, outside #sidebody, so appendChild puts the introduction after the last status group and above the footer.

files.note: The compiled form of the same edit.
The proposed-project page test now asserts the page draws no count line. No test sets projectsReadme, so the introduction's new place is not tested.

groups.title: No plan here names an owner
groups.kicker: Removes the one owner field, which hides the Owner column
intro: Plans can name an owner in frontmatter, and docs/projects/README.md asks for one only where more than one person could own a project. review-scripts was the only plan in this repository that named one, so the Owner column was empty on every other row. Removing that field means no plan names an owner, and the page's existing rule leaves the column out.

files.note: Drops owner: ninjudd from a completed plan.
